name: Tableau
description: Tableau lets agents find published data sources, query them, and read workbooks, views, and Pulse metrics on Tableau Cloud with the permissions of the signed-in user. Each user signs in to their own Tableau Cloud site through the browser.

prompts.text: Which region had the highest sales last quarter in the Superstore data source?
Find the dashboards about customer churn and tell me who owns them.
How did the weekly active users metric change over the last month?

apps.name: Tableau
apps.description: Data source queries, workbook and view lookup, and Pulse metrics, over Tableau's MCP server with browser sign-in.
